0:
apk add --no-cache jq;
while true; do
  echo "Checking fileflows status..."
  STATUS=$(curl -s --max-time 3 http://fileflows-server.fileflows:5000/api/status)
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "fileflows unreachable, proceeding"
    exit 0
  fi

  PROCESSING=$(echo "$STATUS" | jq '.processing // 0')
  QUEUE=$(echo "$STATUS" | jq '.queue // 0')
  echo "Processing: $PROCESSING, Queue: $QUEUE"

  if [ "$PROCESSING" -eq 0 ] && [ "$QUEUE" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Processing and Queue are both 0"
    exit 0
  fi

  echo "Processing or Queue > 0, waiting"
  sleep 120
done

sonarr:
  - name: sonarr
    url: http://sonarr:8989
    api_key: ${SONARR__AUTH__APIKEY}
    renamarr:
      enabled: true
      hourly_job: false
      analyze_files: true
    series_scanner:
      enabled: true
      hourly_job: false
radarr:
  - name: radarr
    url: http://radarr:7878
    api_key: ${RADARR__AUTH__APIKEY}
    renamarr:
      enabled: true
      hourly_job: false
      analyze_files: true
